requirements.title: Task Creation - Title
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a task can be saved with a non-empty string in the title field.
Verify error is thrown if title is null or empty.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

requirements.title: Task Creation - Description
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a description.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a task can be saved with a text description.
Verify the description is correctly stored and retrieved from the database.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

requirements.title: Task Creation - Due Date
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a due date.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a task can be saved with a valid date object.
Verify the system rejects invalid date formats.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

requirements.title: Task Creation - Priority Level
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a priority level (low, medium, high).
acceptance_criteria: Verify task can be saved with priority 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.
Verify system rejects priority values outside of the specified set.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

requirements.title: Task Assignment
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to assign tasks to team members.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a user can select a team member from a list and assign them to a task.
Verify the assigned user is correctly updated in the task record.

verse: FR-02: The system shall allow users to assign tasks to team members.

requirements.title: Notification - Task Assignment
requirements.description: The system shall send email notifications when a task is assigned.
acceptance_criteria: Verify an email is triggered immediately upon task assignment.
Verify the email recipient is the assigned team member.

verse: FR-03: The system shall send email notifications when a task is assigned or when a due date is within 24 hours.

requirements.title: Notification - Due Date Proximity
requirements.description: The system shall send email notifications when a due date is within 24 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Verify an email is sent when current_time is within 24 hours of task_due_date.
Verify no email is sent if the due date is > 24 hours away.

verse: FR-03: The system shall send email notifications when a task is assigned or when a due date is within 24 hours.

requirements.title: Filter Tasks - Status
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status (todo, in-progress, done).
acceptance_criteria: Verify selecting 'todo' returns only tasks with status 'todo'.
Verify selecting 'in-progress' returns only tasks with status 'in-progress'.
Verify selecting 'done' returns only tasks with status 'done'.

verse: FR-04: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status (todo, in-progress, done) and priority.

requirements.title: Filter Tasks - Priority
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by priority.
acceptance_criteria: Verify selecting a priority level returns only tasks matching that level.
Verify multiple filters (status + priority) work concurrently.

verse: FR-04: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status (todo, in-progress, done) and priority.

requirements.title: Dashboard - Completion Statistics
requirements.description: The system shall provide a dashboard showing task completion statistics for the current week.
acceptance_criteria: Verify dashboard displays statistics (e.g., count of completed tasks).
Verify statistics only include data from the current calendar week.

verse: FR-05: The system shall provide a dashboard showing task completion statistics for the current week.

requirements.title: API Response Time
requirements.description: The system shall respond to API requests within 500ms under normal load.
acceptance_criteria: Verify 95th percentile of API response times is <= 500ms under normal load.
Verify response time is measured from request receipt to response transmission.

verse: NFR-01: The system shall respond to API requests within 500ms under normal load.

requirements.title: Concurrent User Support
requirements.description: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users.
acceptance_criteria: Verify system stability under a load of 100 simultaneous active sessions.
Verify no degradation in core functionality during 100-user load test.

verse: NFR-02: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users.

requirements.title: System Availability
requirements.description: The system shall be available 99.9% of the time.
acceptance_criteria: Verify uptime percentage is >= 99.9% over a measured period.
Verify downtime does not exceed 8.77 hours per year.

verse: NFR-03: The system shall be available 99.9% of the time.

requirements.title: Password Hashing
requirements.description: User passwords shall be stored using bcrypt hashing.
acceptance_criteria: Verify database records for passwords do not contain plaintext.
Verify the hashing algorithm used is bcrypt.

verse: NFR-04: User passwords shall be stored using bcrypt hashing.

requirements.title: GDPR Compliance
requirements.description: The system shall comply with GDPR data protection requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Verify existence of data deletion (right to be forgotten) mechanism.
Verify existence of data export (portability) mechanism.

verse: NFR-05: The system shall comply with GDPR data protection requirements.
